title: Azmi and the Stony Ground
logline: Azmi plants a hidden seed in Najma, the hardest ground of all.
story: Nothing had ever grown in Najma, who was the guiding star — ground so hard the others laughed when Azmi, who carried determination, resolve, was handed a single seed and told to plant it there. Azmi did not argue; Azmi simply returned each day to tend the barren place. No green came for a long season, and still Azmi watered the stone. Then one morning a thread of root had split the rock from within. What force could not break, patience had quietly opened.
moral: What force cannot break, steady and patient tending opens from within.
